title: Putting a Collection Booking on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Return
content:
Where a customer asks for a returned item on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking authorisation to be brought back by a carrier, a collection booking is put on that return. The booking names the carrier that is to move the item, carries a tracking reference the retailer issues for it, and states the last day the booking may still be used. The result the booking governs is how long it stays usable, counted from the day it is made. The return itself keeps the state it stands in; only the new entry appears on its history, alongside everything else booked against the return, and the customer can quote the tracking reference to the carrier from that moment.

## Booking the collection

The booking is made with `issue_collection_booking_70222685`, which is a tool the agent unlocks and then calls.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `return_authorization_id` | the reference number of the return authorisation the collection belongs to, read from the return authorisation record retrieved for the customer before the call |
| `booking_open_days` | how long the booking stays usable, as a whole number of days counted from today, which fixes the last day it may be used; a plain integer with no unit suffix and no decimal part, never negative, and 0 means the booking may be used only today |
| `carrier_name` | who is to move the item back, exactly one of the four values below |

`carrier_name` takes exactly one of: `retailer_van`, the retailer's own crew collects the item from the customer's address; `national_parcel`, the item travels back through the parcel network on a label; `regional_freight`, a freight crew collects a palletised or large appliance item; `customer_delivered`, the customer brings the item to a store counter themselves.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the collection booking entry reference that was created, the carrier recorded on it, the tracking reference issued for the movement, and the last day the booking may be used as a calendar date. The sentence appearing at all means the entry was written and is visible on the return's history from then on.
